# harborpilot_notification_rule (Resource)

Routes matching events to notification channels with grouping, hysteresis and quiet hours.

Changes made outside Terraform are detected on refresh and shown as a diff of `spec`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_notification_rule" "quota" {
  name = "quota-alerts"
  spec = jsonencode({
    channel_ids      = [harborpilot_notification_channel.telegram.id]
    filter           = { events = ["quota.*", "budget.*"], min_severity = "warning" }
    cooldown_seconds = 1800
    recovery         = true
    enabled          = true
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name (lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`).
- `spec` (String) The notification rule specification as JSON, usually written with `jsonencode({...})`. See the `NotificationRuleSpec` schema in the Harbor Pilot API reference. Properties you leave out are sent as their zero value (empty string, list or map, `0`, `false`), except `enabled`, which must be set.

### Read-Only

- `drift_state` (String) `drifted` when the object was changed outside Terraform since Terraform last wrote it.
- `id` (String) Stable object id.
- `managed_by` (String) Source of the last change (`terraform` after an apply).
- `revision` (Number) Server revision, used for optimistic concurrency.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id or by name.
terraform import harborpilot_notification_rule.example <id-or-name>
```
